description: This file defines a class Kint_Parsers_Timestamp which extends a parser class to interpret and handle timestamps, specifically in contexts where timestamps are in string or integer forms. It includes methods to determine if a variable fits the timestamp criteria and to parse such variables into formatted date strings.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_Timestamp
classes.description: A parser class specialized in recognizing and parsing timestamp values from variables.

methods.name: _fits
methods.description: Checks if a given variable is likely a timestamp, based on its length and content.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses the variable as a timestamp if it fits the criteria and formats it into a date string.
